o.text: From Old Anatolian Turkish چپار / چاپار / چپر (çapar). By surface analysis, çap- + -ar. Akin to Persian چاپار (čâpâr), a Turkic borrowing.
Likely borrowed from Ottoman Turkish قائب ایتمك. Compare Turkish kaybetmek, from the Arabic-derived kayıp + Turkish etmek, and its Gagauz cognate kaybetmää.
